baslik: Kurul Kalesi: 2.000 yıl önce yandı, kimse geri dönmedi
style: 2D cartoon comic illustration for a vertical 9:16 Instagram Reel. Detailed background in fine black ink linework with cross-hatching and soft watercolor wash, warm sepia paper texture mixed with Black Sea greens and teal. Characters are simple stick figures with a plain white round head, two small black dot eyes and tiny simple eyebrows and mouth for expression, thin black limbs, small flat-colored clothing pieces (red, ochre, green, blue). Characters sit clearly on top of the detailed background like a separate layer. Leave the top 12% and the middle band calm for a watermark and subtitles. No text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark.

scenes.anlatim: Ordu'dan sadece on üç kilometre uzakta, sivri bir kayanın tepesinde, iki bin yıldan uzun zaman önce bir kale yandı. Ve oraya bir daha kimse yerleşmedi.
scenes.prompt: Low-angle dramatic view of a sharp pointed rocky peak rising above a deep green river valley, ruins of a Hellenistic stone fortress on its summit with thin smoke rising into a dusky orange sky. Hazelnut orchards and a winding modern road at the bottom. In the foreground a stick-figure narrator in a green jacket stands on the road looking up with a surprised expression.

scenes.anlatim: Burası Kurul Kalesi. Roma'ya kafa tutan Pontus kralı Mithridates'in, Melet vadisini bekleyen kalelerinden biri.
scenes.prompt: A stick-figure Pontic king with a small golden diadem and long purple cloak stands on the fortress wall atop the rocky peak, pointing down at a winding river valley. Banners with an eight-rayed star and crescent emblem flutter on the towers. The Black Sea glimmers far on the horizon. Two stick-figure guards with round bronze shields stand beside him.

scenes.anlatim: Kayaya oyulmuş yaklaşık üç yüz basamak, su sarnıçları ve erzakla dolu altmışa yakın küp. Kale uzun bir kuşatmaya hazırdı.
scenes.prompt: Cutaway view inside the rock: a long staircase carved directly into the stone descends deep into the mountain toward an underground water cistern. Next to it a storage room filled with rows of large clay pithos jars. Stick-figure soldiers in ochre tunics carry grain sacks and water jars down the steps. Torchlight, warm shadows.

scenes.anlatim: Ama Roma geldi. Kazıcılar yanık toprağın içinde Roma lejyonerlerinin pilum mızraklarını ve surları sökmek için kullanılan orak-mızrağı buldu.
scenes.prompt: Siege scene at the fortress walls: stick-figure Roman legionaries in red tunics, metal helmets and curved rectangular shields climb the rocky slope and hurl long iron-shanked javelins (pila). One legionary uses a long pole with a curved hooked blade to pull stones off the battlements. Arrows in the air, flames starting on a wooden tower. Dramatic, dark sky.

scenes.anlatim: Kale yandı ve terk edildi. Üstüne kimse yeni bir şey kurmadığı için her şey düştüğü yerde kaldı.
scenes.prompt: The burned fortress at night after the battle: charred wooden beams, collapsed walls, broken clay pithos jars spilling grain, a single Roman javelin stuck in the ash. Silent and empty, moonlight, wisps of smoke. Grass and moss beginning to creep over the stones.

scenes.anlatim: Ve iki bin on altıda toprağın altından oturan bir tanrıça çıktı: Kybele. Kucağında hâlâ bir sikke duruyordu.
scenes.prompt: Modern archaeological excavation trench on the rocky summit with string grid lines and labelled buckets. Two stick-figure archaeologists in sun hats kneel with trowels and brushes, uncovering a seated marble mother-goddess statue. A small bronze coin rests on the goddess's lap and catches a soft beam of light. One archaeologist has an amazed expression.

scenes.anlatim: Kazılar iki bin onda başladı ve kalenin henüz yarısı bile açılmadı.
scenes.prompt: Present-day view of the excavation site on top of the pointed rock: wooden walkways, white tents, parts of ancient walls exposed while large areas are still covered in earth and grass. A few stick-figure visitors look around. Far in the distance the city of Ordu and the Black Sea under a clear afternoon sky.

scenes.anlatim: Sizce o sikkeyi Kybele'nin kucağına kim bıraktı? Ne diliyordu? Yorumlara yazın.
scenes.prompt: Close-up of the seated marble goddess statue's lap with the small ancient bronze coin. The stick-figure narrator from scene 1 leans in from the side, chin on hand, curious thoughtful expression. Warm soft light, shallow depth, calm background.
